protocol.label: Astex — Vinardo rescoring of the run-4 stored top-20 pose sets (run 5, diagnostic)
protocol.status: PREREGISTERED BEFORE ANY RESULT WAS COMPUTED — frozen protocol, amendments only by append
protocol.question: Does the Vinardo scoring function, applied to exactly the pose sets AutoDock Vina already generated in run 4, rank a native-like pose (RMSD < 2.0 A) first in cases where the Vina function did not?

inputs.poseSets: the run-4 diagnostic pose sets ONLY — the docked.pdbqt written by run 4 for each of the 85 Astex cases
inputs.integrityGate: for every case, sha256(docked.pdbqt) MUST equal the dockedPdbqtSha256 recorded in docs/evidence/astex-redock-run4-diagnostic.json and sha256(receptor.pdbqt) MUST equal receptorPdbqtSha256; a case whose files do not match, or are missing, is reported as UNAVAILABLE and is NOT re-docked and NOT dropped from the denominator
inputs.dataset: Astex Diverse Set, github.com/rdk/p2rank-datasets, joined/astex, commit 0236ecb38cbb60b89849a1ea36fbd9ee93f3e906

forbidden: any change to sampling (exhaustiveness, seed, num_modes, energy_range, min_rmsd)
any change to the receptor, the ligand, the structures or the box
any change to the success threshold (RMSD < 2.0 A) or the denominator (85)
any local optimisation, minimisation or relaxation of a pose (Vina optimize() is NOT called)
any per-target or per-PDB tuning, exception or manual intervention
any modification of runs 1, 2, 3 or 4, their evidence files, or the run-1 preregistration

method.engine: AutoDock Vina 1.2.7 python API with sf_name='vinardo'
method.receptor: the run-4 receptor.pdbqt for that case, plus the same extraRigidPdbqt list run 4 recorded for that case
method.maps: compute_vina_maps(center, box_size) with the center and boxSize recorded by run 4 for that case — unchanged
method.scoring: each retained pose is loaded as a single-model PDBQT at its stored coordinates and scored with Vina.score(); the returned total score is the Vinardo score. Coordinates are never altered.
method.ranking: poses sorted by Vinardo total score ascending (more negative is better); ties broken by the original Vina rank ascending
method.rmsd: NOT recomputed by a new metric — the per-pose symmetry-aware heavy-atom RMSD is recomputed with the identical RDKit CalcRMS code path used in run 4 and MUST equal the run-4 recorded value for that pose to 3 decimals; a mismatch is reported as a failed check, not silently accepted
method.poseIdentity: the run-4 coordinate-derived pose SHA-256 is recomputed and must match, binding this run to run 4's exact poses

prespecifiedMetrics: vinardoTop1Successes / 85 (rank-1 Vinardo pose has RMSD < 2.0 A)
of the 20 cases run 4 classified A_RANKING_FAILURE: how many Vinardo now ranks a native-like pose first (RECOVERED)
of the cases where the Vina rank-1 pose in the run-4 pose set was already native-like: how many Vinardo now ranks a non-native pose first (LOST)
net gain = vinardoTop1Successes minus the run-4 diagnostic Vina top-1 successes (46), on the same pose sets
per case: Vina rank, Vinardo rank, RMSD and both scores for the Vinardo rank-1 pose and for the best-RMSD pose

prespecifiedInterpretation.scoringIsTheBottleneck: net gain >= +5 AND at least 8 of the 20 A_RANKING_FAILURE cases recovered
prespecifiedInterpretation.scoringIsNotTheBottleneck: net gain <= +2 OR fewer than 4 of the 20 recovered
prespecifiedInterpretation.inconclusive: anything between the two — reported as inconclusive, not spun either way
prespecifiedInterpretation.consequence: only if scoringIsTheBottleneck is met is a next SAMPLING experiment proposed for the 17 B_SAMPLING_FAILURE cases; otherwise the proposal is stated to be premature

protocol.reproducibility: the script records per case: input sha256, receptor pdbqt sha256, docked pdbqt sha256; per pose: rank, Vina affinity, Vinardo score, RMSD, pose sha256. A deterministic replay on 2 cases is executed and reported.
